Still on the title, now as `class:text-lg={!collapsed}` — the collapsed row shares its width with two 44px controls, so the title drops to text-base there, matching the mock's smallest state. The gate reports it because it does not read `class:` directives. Moving the size into style.css instead is a trap worth remembering: Tailwind v4 emits a theme variable only when a generated utility references it, so removing `text-lg` from the markup pruned --text-lg and the title silently rendered at the inherited 12px.
